items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: we called him Chippie Alcott... Chippie did some of the writing. And I did, of course.

ctx.x: This is May 8, 1983, at John's house in Washington, D.C., and you had some other things you wanted to say.

Yeah. In talking about the Eckstine band, I mentioned a lot of individuals. In retrospect, I realize that I didn't say enough about some other important people that I could have said some things about.

I'll talk about the arrangers. The principal arranger in the band was Jerry Valentine. He did most of the arranging. Another arranger was the trombone player, another trombone player. His name was...well, we called him Chippie Alcott. Chippie before that had played around with... I think when he came to us, he came to us from Tiny Bradshaw's band. Anyway,
